description: This file provides utility functions for handling JSON files, normalizing repository paths, executing Vitest test runs, and collecting test duration data from reports. It is intended for use within a testing or build tooling context.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a file path to use forward slashes for cross-platform consistency.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a given repository path relative to the root of the repository, handling absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file synchronously.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file; returns a fallback value if an error occurs.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Executes Vitest test runner with JSON reporting, saving output to a specified file.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Processes a Vitest report to extract file durations and test counts, normalizing filenames.
